description: Arbitrum One rollup batch postings to Ethereum L1 and the L1 gas they incurred: the latest SequencerBatchDelivered events on the SequencerInbox with batch number, L1 block and time, data location (blob or calldata), poster, execution gas, blob gas, gas prices and fees in ETH, plus totals. Read from Ethereum mainnet via Etherscan API V2. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_linea_consensys_rollup when you need Linea zkEVM rollup telemetry from the public Linea RPC. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_arbiscan_l2_rollup
title: Arbitrum One rollup batch postings to Ethereum L1
